replacements.new: For every token in the sequence, compute its "relevance" scores (attention weights) with all other tokens,

replacements.new: The 1D path is 0-24 mm after homing the selected axis, at 2 mm intervals, 13 points; for the 2D/Z paths, read the current source code to confirm the safety clearance.

replacements.old: 主控启动可能拉起设备后端；首次调试应在受控条件下进行，不要直接运行旧 EXE。
replacements.new: Starting the controller may launch the device backend; the first debugging should be done under controlled conditions, and do not run the old EXE directly.
